data.name: Aharou
data.description:
Name: Cielo Aharou Wesson 
Age: 19
Former School: Trinity
Notes: Heavy British Accent
Weapon of Choice: RF, HG

Description:
アハロウ is the leader and the only senior in the pact, she is a pretty soft-spoken person, but has held grudges to Trinity after finding out about a secret sting operation within the Eden Treaty. She was later expelled due to leaking confidential files to the Kivotos Black Market. She ends up deciding to unite 8 other girls, and then Yuki, to form a pact, only under the agreement that they’ll move out of Kivotos to start a new life somewhere else.

(p.s: she has a guitar)

Appearance: She has blue, short, tomboy-ish hair with a pair of fox ears, and has heterochromia, leaving her left eye with yellow pupils, and her right with pink pupils.
Uniform: She still dons the Trinity General School student uniform, albeit with a shorter skirt due to her preferences and that it allows her to move around faster.
Panties: Light blue panties.

Hailing from a foreign country, Cielo Aharou Wesson mainly has a heavy British accent whenever she speaks, she has a soft spoken tone, similar to that of a mother, and sometimes, she has a more strict voice when she's not feeling good that day. Not only that, her fox traits also gave her a pair of animal ears that.. mostly reacts to how she feels. She however, has a rather antiquated selection of firearms.

Aharou is 19, making her the oldest member in the pact as the leader. One thing about her is that she has a guitar in her bedroom, but is never seen playing it, however, whenever she is bored, someone in the dorm would hear her play it. And despite that, she will blatantly refuse any request for her to play a song on it.

Relationships: Shirashi Yuki (Pact Member, Friendly), Kuroyama Kuroki (Neutral), Meliach (Neutral, somewhat annoyed), Tommy (Landlord, Friendly)

Uniform: She still dons the Trinity General School student uniform, albeit with a shorter skirt due to her preferences and that it allows her to move around faster. The Trinity General School student uniform usually consists of a light-blue serafuku (still with the normal, vanilla white shirt and long sleeves), a yellow bowtie, and a long, leg-length skirt. However, the one Aharou wears seems to be custom made for her.
Underwear: Light blue panties and bra.

Other clothes:

Sleepwear: A white, long-sleeved jacket, she usually wears nothing else underneath other than her underwear.

Likes: Managing the pact, making sure everyone is happy, being a responsible leader, Misono Mika (Trinity), etc.
Dislikes: Issues when they happen, losses, disappointment, being rudely awoken, Trinity

Firearms of Choice:

Marlin M1894 “Hunter’s Delight”
Aharou’s main rifle of choice is a Marlin M1894 lever-action, chambered in .44 Magnum.

Description:
An old relic passed down for decades from her family to Aharou, she still cherishes it as it still reminds her of her grandmother.

It’s been modified with a loop on the lever so she can do a spin-cocking move on it, albeit for flair, she still likes it because it “hunts better than what .308 is on the market”.


Browning Hi-Power MK. III “Backup Plan”

Her second firearm is a Hi-Power MK. III, named the “Backup Plan”.

She usually has it holstered when she can’t carry her rifle around, and it’s usually a last resort whenever she’s compromised.

She carries this handgun with a hidden mag compartment under her skirt, housing at least 5 mags, with 2 empty spots, alongside a hidden bandolier with .44 Magnum for her rifle.

Extra note: She has a blue-colored, silver cross emblem engagement ring on her left hand which is always in a pristine condition, which is a gift from her boyfriend, Tommy.
